This is the opposite of the requirement (analyzer should still report diagnostics when SuppressSourceGeneration = true, matching 3.1.0). Users who had these diagnostics now silently lose them. Ledger L12 only blesses omitting generation-only diagnostics (011/016/017), not core validation rules.
